description:
Unpause a tenant.

Resumes sending. A tenant that was paused by the reputation guard (bounce or complaint rate) can only be unpaused by a
`trusted` or `internal` team; others get `403 invalid_access` and should contact support.

Requires a `full_access` API key. API: `POST /tenants/{ref}/unpause` (operationId `unpauseTenant`, Tenants).

ref.description: The tenant id or your own `external_id`.

name: unpause_tenant
title: Unpause a tenant
